radio.scope: unchanged R41B actual radio detector, separately running; no duplicate launch

transfer: Reuse R41B competing hypothesis and continuity principles and fail-open/Joint Min retention, not its radio-trained weights on incompatible data; nonradio adapters are new unqualified comparators.

infrared.data: Gaia DR3 positions and proper motions propagated approximately to 2010.5; SkyView WISE 3.4 and 12 micron FITS cutouts (resampled survey images, not individual exposures). Known target list, not independent blind sample. Fixed PSF approximate Gaussian FWHM 6.1/6.5 arcsec, compare fixed stellar vs free centroid within +/-6 arcsec on checkerboard pixel halves, held-pixel error on swapped halves; source flux and 24 ring control apertures. Pixel correlation prevents calibrated significance; no physical source exclusion or assertion. Preserve candidate despite competing fit, report centroid offsets and gains; synthetic fixed/shifted source software test. If unavailable HOLD, no substitute catalog values.
infrared.disclosure: Known follow-up outcomes before test; retrospective stress, not blind; independent raw images and optical/IR calibration required.

orbit.data: JPL SBDB full-precision orbit, covariance if returned, physical parameters and model parameters; one request at a time; distinguish absent acceleration estimate from zero. Record e/sigma, q, inclination, arc, observation count, A1/A2/A3 with units, uncertainties and model. No independent residuals in SBDB solution, no claim of maneuver or origin. List natural-control overlaps.
orbit.synthetic: Separate fixed-seed toy astrometric residual control (not physical ephemeris): 48 time samples, 64 cases per noise/smooth acceleration/impulsive slope-change/periodic residual; fit linear+quadratic, hinge and sinusoidal rivals on first 24 and test future 24; also interleaved halves for interpolation. Fixed hinge events and frequencies, no fitting to real targets; compare heldout errors; no claims of detecting probes, and no real astrometric residual inference. Explicitly distinguish catalog data intake vs actual residual test.

gates: No candidate promotion, no production change. Missing data gives HOLD; report all targets and costs. Need raw astrometry with errors, independent time arcs and natural force models for real orbital tests; actual manufactured positives absent. No evidence of self replication from one object. Optical transit and optical artifact lane not implemented here; later TESS/Palomar with labeled natural controls.
